images.name: bookshelf-background
images.prompt: Paint a cosy, light, warm reading-room wall behind wooden shelf planks drawn later by app code: broad pale cream plaster or subtle wallpaper, a sunlit window confined to the upper-left edge, a slender reading lamp at the far-right edge, one small potted plant at a lower edge, warm floorboards and a soft rug only in the bottom strip, and optional small Vanilla curled asleep in a bottom corner. Keep the central 70% an uninterrupted empty, pale, low-contrast wall with generous crop safety for 4:3 landscape and 3:4 portrait. Match the supplied cover's soft classic watercolour-on-cream-paper style and Vanilla's supplied identity. Absolutely no shelves, bookcase, books, wall frames, readable text, letters, numbers, titles, labels or cluttered middle.

review.attempt_1: REJECT — painted a full bookcase and books through the centre.
review.attempt_2: PASS — empty calm centre, edge-bound props, matching Vanilla, and no text, shelves, bookcase or books.
review.derivation: Both runtime crops were derived from this single accepted 1448x1086 scene master and encoded as WebP at quality 82.

images.name: icon-bookshelf
images.prompt: A centred small wooden bookshelf with colourful books standing securely on its shelves and one open book grounded in front, in the same soft classic watercolour storybook family as the supplied Reading Tree cover. Plain coloured spine bands only: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, titles or labels. Isolated object with generous padding and transparent background, matching the Word Book hub icons.

review.attempt_1: PASS — no readable text, sound shelf geometry, grounded books, clear silhouette and clean transparent corners.
review.derivation: Accepted source normalized to a 512x512 PNG master; runtime encoded at 192x192 as WebP quality 82 with alpha.
